title: Light Canadian Trout Chowder
description: A tangy and crisp Canadian dish featuring trout, perfect for a sick day, made in a hot pot vessel and kosher friendly.
instructions: In a large hot pot vessel, combine the chopped onions, sliced carrots, and chopped celery and cook over medium heat until the vegetables are tender.
Add the diced potatoes, chicken broth, and trout fillets to the vessel and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes or until the potatoes are tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together the milk and flour until smooth.
Stir the milk mixture into the chowder and continue to simmer for an additional 2 minutes or until the chowder has thickened.
Season the chowder with salt, pepper, and dried dill.
Serve the chowder hot, garnished with additional dill if desired.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for later use.
Reheat the chowder over low heat, stirring occasionally, until warmed through.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
